answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 20 POA bond that decays 5% each epoch on a quartz clock; the bond sits on a ledge — miss a top-up and the identity falls off. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must feed 1,000 bonds each epoch, 1,000 POA against a 2,000 POA pool. Each identity is a vertex in the trust graph, and a decayed vertex loses its edges. An honest agent pays once, tops up one bond, and keeps its full share.
